title: 示波器双通道：谁先到、谁后到
summary: CH1 看输入、CH2 看输出，同时比较两个电压的大小和时间：晚到的那个有一个相位差。
concepts: lag / lead 滞后 / 超前
description: 信号发生器 → R1（1 kΩ）→ 结点 OUT → C1（100 nF）→ GND。CH1 看输入，CH2 看 OUT：读出两个峰峰值和相位差。

cards.title: 两个探头，两条波
text: 搭一个电阻加一个**电容**的小电路。电容是 3.3 才正式认识的元件；现在只要知道：它要一点时间才能“充满”。
放两个探头：一个看输入，一个看电容。
屏幕上有黄、青两条波。哪一条先到达波峰？

cards.title: 晚到多少，用角度说
text: - 两条波频率一样、形状一样，只是一条**晚到**一点。晚的时间叫 Δt。
- 像两个人在操场上跑圈：跑完一圈是 360°，落后半圈就是 180°。所以晚到的时间换成角度：
![](fig:lag)
- CH2 比 CH1 晚，就说 CH2 **滞后**，相位差记成负数。屏幕下面直接显示“相位差 CH2 相对 CH1”。
![](fig:rc)

cards.title: 读两个通道
text: - 把时间/格调到 **`100 µs`**，数一数两个波峰之间隔了几格。
- 两个电压的大小、相位差都在屏幕下面。电压小的那条也是晚到的那条吗？

cards.title: 带走
text: - **CH1 看输入，CH2 看输出**，两个接地夹都夹 GND。
- **φ = Δt / T × 360°**；晚到的一方相位差为负（滞后）。
- 想看 R1 这种两端都不接地的元件的电压，用两个探头看 **CH1 − CH2**（很多示波器有 MATH 功能），不要把接地夹夹到中间去。
- 为什么正好是这个大小、这个角度？第 4 世界用相量来算。

caption.text: CH2 比 CH1 晚 Δt 到达波峰。这张图里 Δt 是四分之一个周期，也就是 −90°；你的电路晚得少一些。

i18n.en: CH2 reaches its peak Δt after CH1. In this picture Δt is a quarter of a period, −90°; your circuit is less late.

caption.text: CH1 接在 R1 左边（输入），CH2 接在 OUT（电容上）。两个接地夹都在 GND。

i18n.en: CH1 on the left of R1 (the input), CH2 on OUT (the capacitor). Both ground clips on GND.

en.title: Two scope channels: who arrives first
en.summary: CH1 on the input, CH2 on the output: compare two voltages' size and timing at once. The one that arrives late has a phase difference.
en.description: Generator → R1 (1 kΩ) → node OUT → C1 (100 nF) → GND. CH1 on the input, CH2 on OUT: read both peak-to-peak values and the phase difference.
en.compare: **Compare**: CH1 ≈ **1.97 Vpp** (the 50 Ω takes a little), CH2 ≈ **1.67 Vpp**; phase difference ≈ **−32°** (CH2 lags), Δt = 32 / 360 × 1 ms ≈ **89 µs**. How to calculate these two: phasors, World 4.
steps: **Function generator**: red clip **`a5`**, black clip **`tn5`**. Keep sine, **`1 kHz`**, amplitude **`1 V`**, offset **`0 V`**.
**Capacitor C1**: click **`d10`** and **`tn12`**, **`100 nF`** (the default). Column 10 is **OUT**.
Second **probe** (CH2, cyan, automatically): tip **`b10`** (OUT), ground clip **`tn15`** (GND). Look at the screen: which wave peaks first?
Set **time/div** to **`100 µs`** and **V/div** of both channels to **`0.5 V`**. How many squares lie between the two peaks?
Press **Check my circuit** and answer the questions from the numbers under the scope screen.
hints: CH1 is the input, CH2 the capacitor voltage; both ground clips on GND.
Phase difference = Δt / T × 360°. CH2 arrives later, so it is negative.
tests: The capacitor voltage is smaller than the input, and later

measurements.explain: A little under 2 Vpp: the generator's 50 Ω takes a little (last lesson).
Smaller than the input: the input turns back before the capacitor has filled up.

measurements.ask: Phase difference: CH2 relative to CH1 (degrees, with its sign)
measurements.explain: About −32°: the minus sign says CH2 lags.

measurements.ask: From your phase reading, how much later is CH2: Δt = |φ| / 360° × T (T = 1 ms)
measurements.explain: About 89 µs: less than one square at 100 µs/div.

measurements.ask: Which channel reaches its peak first?
measurements.explain: CH1 first. The capacitor needs time to charge, so its voltage always follows the input.

cards.title: Two probes, two waves
text: Build a small circuit of a resistor and a **capacitor**. You meet the capacitor properly in 3.3; for now all you need is that it takes a little time to "fill up".
Place two probes: one on the input, one on the capacitor.
There are a yellow and a cyan wave on the screen. Which one reaches its peak first?

cards.title: How late, said as an angle
text: - The two waves have the same frequency and shape; one just arrives a bit **later**. The delay is Δt.
- Like two runners on a track: one lap is 360°, half a lap behind is 180°. So the delay becomes an angle:
- For example 0.25 ms late with a 1 ms period: φ = 0.25 / 1 × 360° = 90°.
![](fig:lag)
- When CH2 comes later than CH1, CH2 **lags** and the phase difference is negative. The screen shows "phase CH2 vs CH1" directly.
![](fig:rc)

cards.title: Read both channels
text: - Set time/div to **`100 µs`** and count the squares between the two peaks.
- Both sizes and the phase difference are under the screen. Is the smaller wave also the later one?

cards.title: Take away
text: - **CH1 on the input, CH2 on the output**, both ground clips on GND.
- **φ = Δt / T × 360°**; the late one has a negative phase difference (it lags).
- To see the voltage across a part with neither end on ground, such as R1, use two probes and look at **CH1 − CH2** (many scopes have a MATH key) — don't move a ground clip to the middle.
- Why exactly this size and this angle? World 4 works it out with phasors.

tests.name: 电容上的电压比输入小、比输入晚

compare: **对比**：CH1 ≈ **1.97 Vpp**（50 Ω 分掉一点），CH2 ≈ **1.67 Vpp**；相位差 ≈ **−32°**（CH2 滞后），Δt = 32 / 360 × 1 ms ≈ **89 µs**。这两个数怎么算出来：第 4 世界的相量。

measurements.explain: 比 2 Vpp 略小：信号发生器的 50 Ω 分掉了一点点（上一课）。
比输入小：电容还没充满，输入就已经往回走了。

measurements.ask: 相位差：CH2 相对 CH1（度，带符号）
measurements.explain: 约 −32°：负号表示 CH2 滞后。

measurements.ask: 用你读到的相位差算 CH2 比 CH1 晚多少时间：Δt = |φ| / 360° × T（T = 1 ms）
measurements.explain: 约 89 µs：在 100 µs/格 时还不到 1 格。
CH1 先到。电容要时间充电，它两端的电压总是跟在输入后面。

steps.text: 第一个**探头**（CH1，黄色）：针尖 **`b5`**（输入），接地夹 **`tn3`**（GND）。
第二个**探头**（自动接 CH2，青色）：针尖 **`b10`**（OUT），接地夹 **`tn15`**（GND）。看屏幕：哪条波先到波峰？
把**时间/格**调到 **`100 µs`**、两个通道的**伏/格**都调到 **`0.5 V`**。两个波峰之间隔了几格？
点**「检查我的电路」**，读示波器屏幕下面的读数完成测量题。

hints: CH1 是输入，CH2 是电容上的电压；两个接地夹都在 GND。
相位差 = Δt / T × 360°。CH2 晚到，相位差为负。
